title: fixmypdf
description: Privacy-first PDF tools over MCP: merge, split, rotate, delete, compress, protect, inspect.
summary: Privacy-first PDF tools over MCP: merge, split, rotate, delete, compress, protect, inspect.
offersHint: Privacy-first PDF tools over MCP: merge, split, rotate, delete, compress, protect, inspect. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://www.fixmypdfonline.com/api/mcp

toolsPreview.name: get_pdf_info
toolsPreview.description: Read-only. Return a PDF's page count and per-page dimensions (in points). Use this first to plan a split or rotate.

toolsPreview.name: merge_pdf
toolsPreview.description: Merge two or more PDFs into one, in the order given. Returns the merged PDF as base64.

toolsPreview.name: split_pdf
toolsPreview.description: Extract an inclusive, 1-based page range from a PDF into a new PDF. e.g. from=5,to=10 keeps pages 5–10. Returns base64.

toolsPreview.name: rotate_pdf
toolsPreview.description: Rotate pages of a PDF clockwise by 90, 180, or 270 degrees. Omit "pages" to rotate every page; otherwise pass 1-based page numbers. Returns base64.

toolsPreview.name: delete_pages
toolsPreview.description: Remove specific pages from a PDF by their 1-based page numbers, keeping the rest in order. Returns base64.

toolsPreview.name: compress_pdf
toolsPreview.description: Reduce a PDF's file size losslessly by consolidating object streams (keeps text selectable). Returns base64 plus before/after sizes. Note: does not re-encode embedded images.

toolsPreview.name: protect_pdf
toolsPreview.description: Encrypt a PDF with a password (AES). The result requires the password to open. Returns base64.
